title: Finn Spots an Old Friend
description: When the Millennium Falcon lands at the Resistance Base, BB-8 races down the exit ramp toward Poe Dameron's black X-wing. The Droid is beeping wildly. Finn can't understand what has gotten into BB-8, until the pilot of the X-wing takes off his helmet. Poe had survived the crash on Jakku and is once again flying for the Resistance.
